tira_sub: The dolls are in charge; I brought a prince
seo_titulo: Cuentos de muñecas: stories with dolls as heroines
seo_desc: Anthology compiled by Magaly Sánchez Ochoa (Editorial de la Mujer, 2015) with the story La muñeca y el príncipe, by Antonio López Sánchez.
cubierta_alt: Cover of Cuentos de muñecas, illustrated by Alain R. Cuba

ficha.título: Cuentos de muñecas (¡A leer y a jugar!) (Doll Stories: Let's Read and Play!)
ficha.autoría: Various authors, compiled by Magaly Sánchez Ochoa
ficha.incluye: La muñeca y el príncipe (The Doll and the Prince), by Antonio López Sánchez

lecturas.texto: Read La muñeca y el príncipe

catalogo.sinopsis: Stories and poems for children with dolls as their protagonists, compiled by Magaly Sánchez Ochoa. The author's first children's story, which gave birth to the characters of his later books.
